long_biography.plain_text:
Rebeiz-Nielsen became a director of Hus Distribution in 2011 and later co-founded Colour Themes with CJ Jones. The dealership developed an international advisory practice spanning acquisitions, collection strategy and institutional projects. He subsequently became a partner and significant shareholder of Colour One, which continues the advisory work from Cork Street.

Alongside private-client work, Rebeiz pursued research and publishing around Jean-Michel Basquiat. Colour Themes spent a decade assembling primary material for an Assouline monograph, combining more than two hundred artworks with archival photographs and interviews. The project placed his advisory practice at the intersection of art-market expertise, scholarship and access to private and public collections.
